constraints.name: profile_focus_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES profiles(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: profile_focus_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX profile_focus_pkey ON app_private.profile_focus USING btree (user_id)

constraints.name: project_contexts_user_id_project_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects(user_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: project_contexts_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX project_contexts_pkey ON app_private.project_contexts USING btree (project_id)

constraints.name: onboarding_entries_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: onboarding_entries_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX onboarding_entries_pkey ON app_private.onboarding_entries USING btree (user_id)

indexes.name: onboarding_entries_source_operation_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX onboarding_entries_source_operation_key ON app_private.onboarding_entries USING btree (source_operation)

constraints.name: onboarding_rounds_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['active'::text, 'paused'::text])) OR (draft IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: onboarding_rounds_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: onboarding_expiry
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX onboarding_expiry ON app_private.onboarding_rounds USING btree (expires_at) WHERE (status <> 'expired'::text)

indexes.name: onboarding_latest
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX onboarding_latest ON app_private.onboarding_rounds USING btree (user_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)

indexes.name: onboarding_one_open
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX onboarding_one_open ON app_private.onboarding_rounds USING btree (user_id) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'paused'::text, 'executing'::text, 'partial'::text]))

indexes.name: onboarding_rounds_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX onboarding_rounds_pkey ON app_private.onboarding_rounds USING btree (id)

indexes.name: onboarding_rounds_user_id_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX onboarding_rounds_user_id_id_key ON app_private.onboarding_rounds USING btree (user_id, id)

constraints.name: onboarding_intents_user_id_round_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id, round_id) REFERENCES app_private.onboarding_rounds(user_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: onboarding_active_ordinal
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX onboarding_active_ordinal ON app_private.onboarding_intents USING btree (user_id, round_id, ordinal) WHERE active

indexes.name: onboarding_active_slot
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX onboarding_active_slot ON app_private.onboarding_intents USING btree (user_id, round_id, slot) WHERE active

indexes.name: onboarding_intents_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX onboarding_intents_pkey ON app_private.onboarding_intents USING btree (id)

indexes.name: onboarding_intents_user_id_round_id_slot_intent_version_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX onboarding_intents_user_id_round_id_slot_intent_version_key ON app_private.onboarding_intents USING btree (user_id, round_id, slot, intent_version)

indexes.name: onboarding_pending
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX onboarding_pending ON app_private.onboarding_intents USING btree (user_id, round_id, ordinal) WHERE (active AND (status <> ALL (ARRAY['confirmed'::text, 'omitted'::text])))

constraints.name: onboarding_commands_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: onboarding_commands_user_id_round_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id, round_id) REFERENCES app_private.onboarding_rounds(user_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: onboarding_commands_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX onboarding_commands_pkey ON app_private.onboarding_commands USING btree (user_id, command, client_id)

constraints.name: onboarding_oauth_flow_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (flow_id) REFERENCES app_private.google_oauth_flows(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: onboarding_oauth_user_id_round_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id, round_id) REFERENCES app_private.onboarding_rounds(user_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: onboarding_oauth_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX onboarding_oauth_pkey ON app_private.onboarding_oauth USING btree (flow_id)

triggers.name: onboarding_oauth_permit_zero
triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER onboarding_oauth_permit_zero AFTER UPDATE ON app_private.onboarding_oauth DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app_private.onboarding_oauth_permit_zero()

constraints.name: onboarding_write_permits_intent_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (intent_id) REFERENCES app_private.onboarding_intents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: onboarding_write_permits_user_id_round_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id, round_id) REFERENCES app_private.onboarding_rounds(user_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.name: onboarding_write_permits_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX onboarding_write_permits_pkey ON app_private.onboarding_write_permits USING btree (intent_id)

triggers.name: onboarding_permit_zero
triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER onboarding_permit_zero AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON app_private.onboarding_write_permits DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION app_private.onboarding_permit_must_be_gone()

indexes.name: onboarding_retention_state_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX onboarding_retention_state_pkey ON app_private.onboarding_retention_state USING btree (singleton)
